info.name: DSS Turn API
info.description:
Decision Support System (DSS) turn API.

One endpoint handles text, image, streaming, and non-streaming turns.
The `Accept` header selects JSON or SSE; it does not change the operation.

Authoritative prose contract: `docs/api-contracts/api-contract.md`.
File input is not supported in v1.

header.description: W3C trace context. DSS starts its server span from this and echoes the trace id as `context.traceId`.

request.description:
Send one turn. A valid turn that DSS handles returns 200 whatever the
domain result — a safe rejection, no match, or a request for more
information is still a 200. The domain result is in `message.outcome`.

With `Accept: text/event-stream` the response is an SSE stream whose
terminal event carries the same canonical turn object. Once the stream
has opened with 200, failures are reported by a terminal `turn.failed`
event; the HTTP status cannot change.

item.name: streaming, released as it is written

header.description: W3C trace context. DSS starts its server span from this and echoes the trace id as `context.traceId`.

request.description: Same body as the streaming request above, on the route that releases the answer as the composer writes it. Expect a claim.delta frame per piece, then claim.completed with the whole block and its citations, then the terminal event. Concatenating the delta texts gives the completed text exactly. SSE only — Accept: application/json here is a 406.
